post.summary: Creates a new account and returns a JWT on success.

400.description: Validation failed or email already taken.

post.summary: Validates credentials and returns a fresh JWT.

get.summary: Lists bonus cards in a game, optionally filtered by player.

parameters.name: playerId
parameters.description: Optional: only return cards held by this player.

put.summary: Assigns a bonus card from the draw pile to a player.

400.description: Card already used or domain rule violated.

put.summary: Marks a bonus card as used (traded in for reinforcements).

get.summary: Lists all continents in a game.
Returns a continent with its territory IDs.
Lists games, optionally filtered by state.

post.summary: Creates a new game with default settings. The caller becomes host.

get.summary: Returns full details for a game including settings and player list.

put.summary: Starts the game (Lobby → InProgress). Only the host may do this.

409.description: Game is not in Lobby state.

put.summary: Ends the game (InProgress → Finished). Only the host may do this.

409.description: Game is not in InProgress state.

put.summary: Sets the current game phase (Deployment / Attack / Fortify).
Sets which player's turn it currently is.

get.summary: Returns the settings for a game.

put.summary: Updates game settings. Only allowed while in Lobby state.

get.summary:
Lists mission cards in a game. When playerId is provided
only that player's card is returned (used for the player to read their own mission).

parameters.name: playerId
parameters.description: Optional: filter to a specific player's mission.

put.summary: Assigns a mission card to a player.

400.description: Mission already assigned or domain rule violated.

put.summary: Marks a mission as completed — the assigned player wins.

400.description: Mission not assigned or already completed.

get.summary: Lists all players in a game.

post.summary: Joins the game as the authenticated user. Only allowed in Lobby state.

400.description: Already in game or game is full.

409.description: Game is not in Lobby state.

get.summary: Returns a single player by ID.

delete.summary: Removes the player from the game. Only allowed in Lobby state and by the player themselves.

put.summary: Adds reinforcement troops to a player's pool.

get.summary: Lists all active territories in a game, optionally filtered by owner.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Optional: filter to territories owned by this player ID.

get.summary: Returns a single territory including its neighbouring territory IDs.

put.summary: Claims an unoccupied territory for a player.
Adds or removes troops from a territory.

400.description: Domain rule violation (e.g. removing more troops than present).

put.summary: Updates the authenticated user's display name.

AssignCardRequest.description: Payload to assign a card to a player.

AssignMissionRequest.description: Payload to assign a mission card to a player.

token.description: Signed JWT — include as `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on subsequent requests.

AuthResponse.description: Returned after a successful register or login.

playerId.description: Holder player ID, or null if in draw pile.

territoryIdentifier.description: Depicted territory slug, or null for Wild cards.

used.description: Whether the card has been traded in.

ClaimTerritoryRequest.description: Payload to claim a territory for a player.

captureBonus.description: Bonus troops for controlling all territories.

territoryIds.description: IDs of territories belonging to this continent.

ContinentDetailResponse.description: Full continent detail including territory IDs.

captureBonus.description: Bonus troops for controlling all territories.

territoryCount.description: Number of territories in this continent.

timer.description: Total game time limit in seconds. 0 = unlimited.

turnTimeLimit.description: Per-turn time limit in seconds. 0 = unlimited.

hasMissions.description: Enable secret mission cards. Default: false.

CreateGameRequest.description: Payload to create a new game. All fields are optional; defaults apply.

hostId.description: Domain user ID of the host.

currentPlayerId.description: Player whose turn it is (null if not started).

startedAt.description: When the game started (null if not yet started).

endedAt.description: When the game ended (null if not finished).

GameDetailResponse.description: Full game details including settings and players.

hostId.description: Domain user ID of the host.

playerCount.description: Number of players currently in the game.

GameSummaryResponse.description: Lightweight game summary for list views.

playerId.description: Assigned player ID, or null if unassigned.

isCompleted.description: Whether the mission has been completed.

gameId.description: The game this player belongs to.

isEliminated.description: Whether the player has been eliminated.

PlayerSummaryResponse.description: Lightweight player summary embedded in game responses.

password.description: Must satisfy the configured password policy (min 12 chars).

RegisterRequest.description: Payload required to create a new account.

troops.description: Number of troops to add (must be positive).

ReinforceRequest.description: Payload to add reinforcement troops to a player.

playerId.description: ID of the player whose turn it now is.

SetCurrentPlayerRequest.description: Payload to set the active player.

SetPhaseRequest.description: Payload to change the current game phase.

ownerId.description: Current owner player ID, or null.

TerritoryDetailResponse.description: Territory detail including neighbouring territory IDs.

ownerId.description: Player ID of current owner, or null if unoccupied.

active.description: Whether the territory is active in this game.

UpdateGameSettingRequest.description: Payload to fully replace game settings.

delta.description: Positive to add troops, negative to remove.

UpdateTroopsRequest.description: Payload to add or remove troops from a territory.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Payload to update a user profile.

id.description: Stable domain user ID (also the JWT sub claim).

UserResponse.description: Public profile of a domain user.
